data.name: PVV: Proxy of Virtue and Vice
data.detailed_description:
Become the chosen "Courier."

A seemingly ordinary delivery mission carries a mysterious package capable of overturning the entire social order. Travel through a heavily surveilled cyberpunk city, searching for the truth between gunfire and deception.

Here, people are trapped within a hive mind, controlled by a collective consciousness. Desire, faith, and reality gradually begin to blur... But before all of that, perhaps it's better to start with a hot, crispy fried chicken leg.

"SeeMe" is watching you.

Game Features

✦ A Cyberpunk Dystopian World

Explore a futuristic city filled with surveillance, lies, and collective consciousness. Uncover the truth through a narrative filled with absurd humor and dark comedy.

✦ Beautiful Anime Characters & Illustrations

Enjoy high-quality character artwork and stunning CGs, packed with anime-inspired easter eggs — because yes, this is a true anime game.

✦ A Massive Arsenal of Bullets

Bullets. Lots of bullets.
Collect and combine bullets with unique effects to create your own combat style.

✦ Diverse Character Progression

Develop your characters through upgrades, abilities, and equipment customization. Experiment with different builds to overcome increasingly challenging battles.

✦ Deep Interaction Between Environment & Combat

Use environmental mechanics and bullet effects creatively, turning the cyberpunk city itself into your most powerful weapon.
